text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey— Who was calling for me just now?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...That's weird. Don't tell me I was just 
hearing things?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps... was it you all who summoned 
me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you setting up quite the 
dramatic scene, Three Goddesses?
